title: Thoubal Police Commandos, 33 AR Recover Arms and Ammunition During Joint Search Operation
summary: Thoubal Police Commandos and 33 Assam Rifles recover SMG carbines, guns, pistols, hand grenades, detonators and ammunition during a joint search operation at Ikop Pat.
body:
Thoubal, October 28, 2026: Thoubal Police Commandos and the 33 Assam Rifles (AR) recovered a cache of arms and ammunition during a joint search operation in the general area of Ikop Pat in Thoubal district on Wednesday.

According to the details shared, the joint operation led to the recovery of the following items:

SMG carbines – 2

Double/single-barrel guns – 4

Pistols – 3

Hand grenades – 4

Detonators – 2

Assorted live ammunition – 39 rounds

Assorted magazines

The recovered weapons, explosives and ammunition were seized by the security personnel.
